Lane `check/M0-a-04-close-s5` ran under Opus 5.5 in Claude Code in a Claude Code cloud container (Linux x64, Intel
Xeon 4 cpu, 16 GiB, Node v24.12.0) on 2026-10-14 from 04:09 until 10:10, in two parts: a container restart at about 06:30 killed the first part's RELATED run unfinished; the seat resumed at 06:43 by the continue rule (its lane lines and scratch files read, the mirror `ma` `diff -rq`-equal to the tree, RELATED re-run whole). The machine check
(`tools/machine_profile.py --id`) printed `linux:Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.80GHz:4cpu:16gib`, which matches the
brief; `tools/test_budget.py` gave W = 1 and one mutant at a time throughout.

The seat is an implementer-side closing checker (J162). It wrote no part of the item. It is not `build/M0-a-04-fix-s5`
(C-0373, L-0556), the round's builder, nor an earlier author or checker of M0-a-04. The round it closes is the SESSION's
hardening round S5 of M0-a-04 (J237 (2); the inventory `checks/hardening-inventory.md`, J355), on six FIX-NOW rows —
M0-a-04:16 N-6, :27 N-10, :45 N-13, :113 N-c2-1, :115 N-c2-3, M0-a-05:177 N-c2-6 — and the queue row L1. When the seat started the lane log

## New findings (notes, not blockers; rows in `checks/M0-a-04-notes.md`, "Closing check of S5")

* **N-c5-1** — F1g survives: WEDGE_S cannot tell the sub-edge the exact position falls on from the NEXT one (S is the
  nearer end of both for (314, 3 190)). The code is right: the seat's probe over 995 positions along WEDGE_S's run
  (L2, `placePoint` from `he[8]`) gives 600 fallbacks, 370 of them onto (723, 3 092) for an exact position on the
  first sub-edge nearer its start (s ≤ 74/200 of the route) — the nearer end of that sub-edge — where F1g answers S
  every time. A further hardening test (the promise held, CONFIRMED), not a blocker. M4.
* **N-c5-2** — CM3 survives: no case holds the assertion's boundary `e = −2` (a row on vertex slot 0). The code's bound
  is `rowElement`'s. M4.
* **N-c5-3** — N-13's scanner misses contrived shapes (seat's probe on planted text): a `const` typed by a function
  type with untyped parameters, a `this` pseudo-parameter first, a type alias of `InsertTx`, a parenthesised arrow, an
  anonymous `export default function`, an object-literal method, and code after a regex literal holding a quote. None
  occurs in the five sources (no regex literal there). Deliberate-writer escapes (N-45). M4.
* **N-c5-4** — the round's census record misstates one family: attractVertex `E_LEVEL` 459 of 10 000 at seed 5 (415
  at seed 11), not 0; before = after, so the J264 bar holds. For the session (C-0373 and the S5 section quote "0 of
  10 000"): correct the figure where the census is carried forward.
